summary: Iter 30 — Validated (a) payslip DM now comes from the 'Service RH' identity and (b) automatic welcome DM with 7 in-app links on user creation. Backend: 21/21 pytest assertions pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter30_rh_channel.py). Frontend: Playwright verified Idriss's 'Service RH' channel (name, blue RH avatar, clickable payslip card -> /documents/payslip/emp-idriss-malonga/2026/10 renders the real bulletin) and a freshly-created user (Léa TestQA) whose Messagerie contains exactly ONE 'Service RH' channel (1 unread) with the welcome message and 7 link cards; all 7 links navigate in-app to /documents, /documents?category=Reglement, /rh/planning, /rh/badgeage, /rh/demandes, /restaurant, /avantages (all PASS, no 404/error). Regressions OK: Marcus sees ch-accueil (200), new user sees no team channels and gets 403 on ch-accueil messages, payslip preview for Marcus gross = 4549.0. Test artifacts cleaned up (Léa user + payslip deleted via API; leftover DM/notifications purged).

minor.issue: Deleting a user leaves the rh-{uid} channel and its welcome message orphaned in DB (4 orphan rh-* channels found from previously deleted wizard users). Suggest cascading delete of channels/messages/channel_reads.
For the created user, email == personal_email (no @mspark.fr professional address generated) when no work email is supplied — check if the wizard is expected to derive one.
rh-emp-marcus-simeo channel has duplicated members_ids ['emp-marcus-simeo','emp-marcus-simeo'] when the admin sends a payslip to himself; de-duplicate members_ids and set members=len(set(...)).

After DELETE /api/admin/payslips/{pid}, the payslip page still renders a fully computed bulletin for that period (no 404), and the DM attachment left in the thread stays 'valid'. Low impact but data no longer reflects a real record.

Auth-playbook items are NOT implemented in this app: passwords are stored/compared in plaintext (no bcrypt $2b$ hash), no httpOnly session cookie (client sends X-Employee-Id header, spoofable), no brute-force lockout after 5 failures. Also must_change_password=true is not enforced — Léa logged in with the temp password and reached /dashboard directly. Informational: app-wide design choice, flag to product owner.

integration_issues.issue: Message body still shows raw markdown '[Ouvrir ma fiche de paie](/documents?payslip=...)' as plain text — message content is not markdown-rendered. Cosmetic, legacy data from a previous iteration; new messages don't embed markdown links.

action_items: Optional: cascade-delete rh-{uid} channel + messages when an employee is deleted (orphan channels accumulating).
Optional: de-duplicate members_ids when the admin sends a payslip to himself.
Optional: render/strip markdown links in message content, or migrate the legacy September DM.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_create_user: the welcome-DM insert is not wrapped in try/except unlike the planning seed — a channel insert failure would 500 the whole user creation after the employee doc is already persisted (partial state).
server.py is very large (>5000 lines); messagerie/payslip/user-admin routers should be split into modules.

Consider making rh-{uid} channel creation idempotent via upsert (currently insert_one in admin_create_user vs find/insert in admin_send_payslip — a duplicate-key crash is possible if a channel with that id already exists).
